Events from life of Jaswant Singh Khalra, a human rights activist who worked to identify thousands of unnamed individuals cremated during a period of unrest in Punjab during the 1990s.
Khalra’s work was driven by the belief that every individual deserves dignity, even in death. He focused on facts, documents, and the quiet but powerful act of asking questions. His story has since been remembered by human rights groups and educational institutions.
Punjab 95 - an upcoming film brought his work and his case in limelight again.
